title: Senior 3d artist generalist
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior 3d artist generalist em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Company    Enver is a leading VR game studio and publisher headquartered in New York City. We build viral, social gaming worlds and are known for top-tier publishing and marketing, with creator-led campaigns behind some of the biggest titles in VR, including chart-topping games on Meta Quest. Our specialty is social, live-ops driven multiplayer games built around communities, creators, and content loops.      About the Role    A free to play, social VR game for Meta Quest. You are the senior artist on a small team and the go-to for everything visual. Your core responsibility is making art: environments, characters, props, effects and UI, from concept to optimized, in-engine assets. Alongside that you help define the art direction, plan the art schedule, and distribute tasks across the other artists. Management responsibilities are light. Most of your week is spent building.    The cycle is fast. Ideas become playable prototypes in weeks, with a custom character and a custom environment in that window, and games that go forward move into live ops with new content every few weeks. What you make reaches real players quickly, and you see the reaction the same week.      Responsibilities Model, texture and ship game-ready 3 D assets: environments, characters, props and world dressing Build VR environments that are fun to move through and easy to read, with clear landmarks and good visibility between players Create VFX using VFX Graph or Particle System Build UI and in-world interactive pieces that work well in VR Set up assets in Unity: materials, prefabs, lighting, LODs and collision, ready for developers to use Optimize for Meta Quest: draw calls, texture atlases, poly budgets, lighting and shader cost Help define the art style and keep it consistent across the game Plan the art schedule with the PM, distribute tasks across the artists, and keep the project board accurate Keep shipping new content for live ops after launch: cosmetics, maps, seasonal items Collaborate daily with design, engineering and production in a fully remote team    Qualifications 3+ years as a 3 D artist or generalist in games, with at least one shipped title supported post-launch Shipped VR or mobile work with tight performance budgets, ideally Meta Quest Strong across the full 3 D pipeline: high and low poly modeling, UVs, baking, texturing, and Unity integration Environment art: set dressing, props, terrain and lighting Character art: stylized characters, skins and cosmetics that read well in VR Rigging: skeletons, skinning and weight painting for characters and props Animation: keyframe and looping animations for characters, props and UI, set up in Unity's Animator VFX: VFX Graph or Particle System, plus simple shader work in Shader Graph Materials and shaders: PBR and stylized workflows, texture atlases, material setup in URP Optimization for Meta Quest: poly and texture budgets, draw calls, LODs, lightmaps and baked lighting Stylized, vibrant, readable art. Simple shapes and bold colors that appeal to a young audience Comfortable in Blender or Maya, Substance Painter, and Unity (URP) Excellent communication: you share work early, take feedback well, and thrive in an async remote environment    Bonus Skills Concept art or illustration Marketing art: store screenshots, trailers, key art, creator assets Understanding of the VR market    Pay range and compensation package   $1,500 to $3,500 USD per month      Equal Opportunity Statement    We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices.

title: Senior ai & automation engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ai & automation engineer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

At GBL Tech, we drive high-impact technology careers through specialization and scale. We operate across critical digital ecosystems — from Fintech to Smart Industry — connecting talent with technically challenging projects and modern stacks.      The Role  We're looking for a Senior AI & Automation Engineer to help shape the next generation of intelligent automation and Agentic AI solutions. This role combines software engineering, data automation, workflow orchestration, and Generative AI, with a strong focus on turning complex operational processes into intelligent, scalable, and industrialized solutions.    Your Mission:  Intelligent Automation: Design and develop advanced automation solutions using the Dataiku platform , combining data pipelines, workflows, application integrations, and AI capabilities.  Agentic AI Development: Build intelligent workflows around AI agents and LLMs , leveraging Dataiku LLM Mesh to bring language models into real-world automated processes.  Workflow & Data Orchestration: Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and automated workflows, ensuring seamless coordination between data, applications, and AI components.  Integration & Industrialization: Connect automation solutions with existing IT ecosystems through APIs and application services while implementing robust practices for deployment, monitoring, version control, and governance.  Platform Evolution: Contribute to the development of the Smart Automation & Agentic AI capability by defining technical standards, improving engineering practices, and helping industrialize new automation patterns.  Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance to other developers, mentor junior profiles, and collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to solve complex automation challenges.    What We Are Looking For:  Dataiku Expertise: Experience across software development, process automation, data engineering, or data automation, with strong hands-on expertise in the Dataiku platform .  Generative AI: Practical experience integrating LLMs through Dataiku LLM Mesh , with a strong understanding of prompt engineering , contextualization, instructions, and constraints.  Automation & Development: Strong Python skills combined with experience in data pipelines, workflow automation, API integration, and process orchestration.  Engineering Practices: Solid knowledge of Git , CI/CD , Dev Ops practices, deployment automation, and software development best practices.  Cloud & Integration: Experience working with APIs, application services, and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP  Communication: Fluent English and excellent communication skills.  This position requires availability to relocate to Portugal      Interested?    If this project speaks to you, or you're looking for a similar challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sr. market research analyst
description:
Confira a vaga para Sr. market research analyst em barueri. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights e consultoria, que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!      O que buscamos:    A Worldpanel está em busca de um(a) Analista de Pesquisa de Mercado Sênior com interesse genuíno em entender o comportamento do consumidor e transformar dados em insights que orientem decisões estratégicas. Se você tem espírito investigativo, atenção aos detalhes e gosta de trabalhar com dados e pessoas, essa vaga pode ser para você!    As responsabilidades incluem: Estar diretamente envolvido no plano anual de negócios sendo parte estratégica do desenvolvimento e evolução do mesmo, como líder no dia-a-dia da conta e do desenvolvimento do relacionamento com o cliente. Seguindo os requisitos abaixo: Identificação de Oportunidades Comerciais: entendimento profundo do negócio do cliente, conectando oportunidades comerciais às necessidades dos clientes; Desenvolvimento de Propostas Comerciais: desenvolver propostas comerciais junto a equipe interna e, apoiar na negociação de vendas com clientes; Gestão de Projetos: liderança de projetos do início ao fim – briefing até a apresentação para o cliente. Garantindo conexão com o negócio do cliente, qualidade e agilidade nas entregas. Liderança por influência: Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com fornecedores e parceiros internos para garantir a qualidade e a eficiência dos projetos e propostas comerciais Mentorear e supervisionar atividades dos membros juniores da equipe, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo qualidade e agilidade nas entregas;    Requisitos: Destacado conhecimento analítico para conectar os dados com necessidades/recomendações para os clientes. Construção de relacionamentos sólidos com clientes com ênfase em satisfação e identificação de oportunidades comerciais. Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e construção de relacionamento com diferentes times/culturas. Inglês Avançado    Numerator is a data company transforming how consumers and markets are understood. Powered by advanced technology and proprietary, zero-party purchase and survey data from more than one million households, Numerator provides visibility into consumer behavior and attitudes across consumer goods, retail, restaurants, tech and media, management consulting, institutional investors, and the public sector. Headquartered in Chicago, Numerator drives decisions at the world’s largest and fastest-growing companies in more than 50 countries.

title: Supervisor técnico operacional (remoto)
description:
Empresa está contratando Supervisor técnico operacional (remoto) em barueri. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a Gruen    Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.  Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.  Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.  Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.    Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.    Supervisor Técnico Operacional – Remoto    Atribuições Apoiar as equipes técnicas durante as atividades de montagem, instalação e manutenção em campo. Participar das atividades de startup, comissionamento e colocação em operação dos equipamentos, em conjunto com as equipes mecânica, elétrica e de automação. Ajustar e parametrizar equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos, garantindo seu correto funcionamento. Auxiliar na verificação das interfaces e da integração entre os diferentes módulos e sistemas da planta. Realizar configuração, testes e suporte em sistemas de comunicação industrial, como Profinet, Profibus, PROFIBUS PA, AS-Interface e outros protocolos aplicáveis. Acompanhar remotamente os principais parâmetros operacionais das plantas de biogás/biometano, identificando desvios de processo, alarmes e condições anormais de operação. Atuar no diagnóstico de falhas considerando a integração entre automação, instrumentação, equipamentos e processo de produção de biogás/biometano. Apoiar a análise de variáveis de processo relacionadas à produção, tratamento, compressão e/ou utilização do biogás/biometano, conforme a configuração de cada planta. Interpretar tendências e históricos de processo para auxiliar na identificação de causas de falhas e na prevenção de paradas operacionais. Ter visão sistêmica da operação da planta, compreendendo a relação entre equipamentos, instrumentos, válvulas, sistemas de controle e as etapas do processo de biogás/biometano. Atuar de forma preventiva na identificação de condições que possam comprometer a disponibilidade, segurança ou eficiência operacional das plantas.  Qualificações Técnico / Engenharia Elétrica, Automação, Instrumentação ou áreas correlatas. Conhecimento em Autocad, Eplan, programação Siemens e Rockwell. Conhecimento em instrumentação industrial / válvulas, transmissores, sensores; Conhecimento em rede ASI, Profibus, Profinet; Habilitação categoria B. .    Será visto como um diferencial:    Será considerado um diferencial relevante possuir experiência no segmento de biogás e/ou biometano, especialmente em operação, automação, instrumentação ou suporte técnico de plantas. É desejável que o profissional tenha capacidade de compreender o processo produtivo e relacionar variáveis de processo, alarmes, instrumentos e equipamentos às condições de operação da planta, contribuindo para diagnósticos mais rápidos, prevenção de falhas e maior disponibilidade operacional.    Benefícios Regime de contrato CLT. Regime Home Office Totalpass Salário competitivo ao do mercado. Vale transporte. Vale refeição (Flash Benefícios) Plano de saúde. Plano Odontológico Seguro de vida

title: Patient recruitment specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Patient recruitment specialist em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Patient Recruitment Specialist - 6-month contract - 40 hours per week - Brazil (remote in country)     Join a leading clinical research organisation and play a key role in supporting global patient recruitment and retention activities across multiple clinical trials.      The Role    Working closely with Patient Recruitment & Engagement Leads, you will help deliver recruitment and retention strategies, coordinate study materials, oversee translation and print/distribution processes, and provide operational project support to ensure studies are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.      Key Responsibilities     Support patient recruitment and retention activities across multiple clinical studies. Coordinate the translation, review, tracking, printing, and shipment of patient-facing materials. Maintain study trackers, site databases, inventory records, and recruitment reports. Liaise with vendors, study teams, and sites to ensure smooth delivery of recruitment materials and services. Assist with project management activities, including meeting coordination, action tracking, reporting, invoicing, and document filing. Create engaging site communications, newsletters, and study updates. Monitor budgets, shipment activity, and study metrics, escalating risks where required.    Requirements Previous experience in clinical research, trial operations, patient recruitment, or project coordination. Strong organisational and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency with tracking tools, reporting systems, and Microsoft Office applications. Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment. Fluent English, both written and verbal.    This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organised clinical operations professional looking to gain broad exposure to patient recruitment, study management, and global clinical trial delivery.

title: Revenue accountant
description:
Confira a vaga para Revenue accountant em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.      MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.      The Opportunity      We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.      You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.      What You Will Own     Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and Rev Ops on deal structuring and billing questions Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle    What We're Looking For     4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact ERP experience (Net Suite, Sage Intacct, Quick Books, or equivalent) Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Strong analytical and organizational skills Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant Availability for US time zone overlap    Preferred     Saa S, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or Net Suite ARM CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit    Why Join MAVI?     Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles Flexible remote-first work culture Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

title: Head of accounting
description:
Empresa está contratando Head of accounting em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About MAVI      MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.      We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.      The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.      Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.      The Role      We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.      This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.      Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.      The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.      You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.      What You'll Own      The Close and Financial Reporting     The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time. The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors. Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them. Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it. Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.    Controls, Policy, and Audit     Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established. Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual. Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out. External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.  Accounting Operations   The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards. Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them. Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.    Team, Systems, and Standard     Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client. Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across Net Suite, Quick Books Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation. A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.    What We're Looking For     10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Quick Books Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , Rippling, or Flo Qast Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded Saa S or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field    Who This Role Is For      This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.      You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.      Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.      Why Join Through MAVI     Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day    Work Arrangement      This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.    Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Nova oportunidade para Assessor de investimentos em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Assessor(a) de Investimentos | Performance Invest      Sobre a Performance Invest      A Performance Invest é uma assessoria de investimentos voltada a pessoas físicas e jurídicas, com atuação baseada em relacionamento próximo, estratégia e visão de longo prazo.    Unimos a experiência de profissionais com sólida trajetória no mercado financeiro à estrutura e tecnologia da XP Investimentos, oferecendo soluções personalizadas para diferentes momentos e objetivos patrimoniais.    Estamos ampliando nosso time e buscamos Assessores de Investimentos que já atuam no mercado e desejam encontrar uma estrutura que valorize sua autonomia, relacionamento com os clientes e potencial de crescimento.      Sobre a oportunidade      O profissional será responsável pela gestão do relacionamento e desenvolvimento de sua carteira de clientes, identificando necessidades, objetivos e perfil de cada cliente para apoiá-lo na tomada de decisões de investimento, sempre dentro das atribuições aplicáveis ao Assessor de Investimentos.      Principais responsabilidades:     Gestão do relacionamento e desenvolvimento da carteira de clientes; Prospecção e expansão da base de relacionamento; Identificação do perfil, objetivos e necessidades patrimoniais dos clientes; Apoio na construção e acompanhamento de carteiras de investimentos, observados o perfil e os objetivos do cliente e as atribuições regulatórias do Assessor de Investimentos; Acompanhamento de mercado, produtos e oportunidades de investimento; Relacionamento próximo e consultivo com os clientes; Acompanhamento periódico das carteiras e das necessidades dos clientes; Atuação em conformidade com as normas e regulamentações aplicáveis ao mercado financeiro.    Requisitos     Certificação ANCORD e credenciamento regular para atuação como Assessor(a) de Investimentos; Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência como Assessor(a) de Investimentos; Possuir carteira ativa de clientes, independentemente do tamanho; Experiência com relacionamento, atendimento e prospecção de clientes; Conhecimento de produtos financeiros, investimentos, alocação de ativos e relação entre risco e retorno; Perfil comercial e capacidade de prospecção e desenvolvimento de relacionamento; Postura ética, autonomia e visão de longo prazo.    Por que fazer parte da Performance Invest?      Acreditamos que, para entregar uma experiência de excelência aos clientes, o assessor também precisa encontrar um ambiente que valorize seu trabalho e seu desenvolvimento.    Por isso, na Performance Invest, o assessor também é tratado como cliente, contando com uma estrutura pensada para proporcionar autonomia, flexibilidade e condições competitivas para crescer.      Nossos diferenciais:     Modelo de trabalho flexível: 100% remoto ou híbrido, de acordo com a preferência do assessor; Flexibilidade de horários; Estrutura e suporte para desenvolvimento da carteira; Autonomia e relacionamento próximo com o escritório; Acesso ao ecossistema e às soluções da XP Investimentos.    Se você já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos e procura uma estrutura para desenvolver sua carteira com mais autonomia, flexibilidade e condições competitivas, queremos conhecer você.

title: Coordenador(a) fiscal - faturamento
description:
Confira a vaga para Coordenador(a) fiscal - faturamento em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.    Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.    O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.      COORDENADOR(A) FISCAL - FATURAMENTO    Responsável pela coordenação da equipe fiscal de faturamento, composta por assistentes e analistas, garantindo a continuidade das operações dos Centros de Distribuição do Grupo Petrópolis. Atua como principal referência técnica da área para assuntos relacionados à emissão de documentos fiscais, regras tributárias, parametrizações de sistema e suporte às áreas de negócio além de garantir a integridade das operações de faturamento, reduzir riscos fiscais, corrigir falhas de processo e garantir que o faturamento ocorra sem impactos para a operação.        Principais atividades      O principal objetivo da função é garantir a continuidade do faturamento de todas as empresas do Grupo, removendo impedimentos operacionais, apoiando tecnicamente a equipe e assegurando o cumprimento das regras fiscais aplicáveis.     Acompanhar o faturamento das empresas, validando a correta aplicação das regras tributárias e atuando rapidamente em situações que possam interromper a emissão de documentos fiscais. Acompanhar o volume de Documentos fiscais emitidos, pendentes, rejeitados, canceladas ou em contingência. Realizar alinhamentos diários com a equipe para distribuir demandas críticas e identificar gargalos ou erros. Atuar como o primeiro nível de escalonamento para dúvidas fiscais trazidas pela equipe. Identificar e corrigir possíveis erros de parametrização que estejam travando ou impactando o faturamento. Acompanhar o funcionamento das integrações e automações utilizadas no faturamento, identificando falhas e acionando as áreas responsáveis quando necessário. Validar e autorizar faturamentos ou correções que envolvam valores ou operações fiscais atípicas. Realizar reuniões individuais (1:1 ) com membros do time para acompanhar a produtividade, dar feedbacks e apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico. Atualizar e aplicar a escala de trabalho, banco de horas e plantões de faturamento da equipe Manter comunicação constante com a área Comercial e Logística para alinhar novos fluxos operacionais ou novas demandas de faturamento Revisar processos da área e propor melhorias que reduzam atividades manuais, aumentem a produtividade da equipe e diminuam ocorrências operacionais. Acompanhar as alterações em legislações estaduais e estruturar roteiros/manuais simplificados de faturamento para o time aplicar      Requisitos     Graduação completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou Direito. Experiência consolidada em faturamento e regras de emissão de NF-e, Ct-e e MDF-e. Domínio profundo da legislação tributária (Federal, Estadual e Municipal) e impostos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS) Conhecimento prático em regras da Reforma Tributária (IVA / CBS / IBS). Conhecimento prático do ERP SAP (diferencial módulo SD) Experiência com gestão de equipes. Pacote Office e utilização de dashboards gerenciais. Necessária ampla flexibilidade de horário para acompanhar diferentes turnos e apoiar a equipe quando necessário. Operação funciona em múltiplos turnos (manhã, tarde, noite e madrugada).      Diferencial:      Vivência em faturamento de distribuição e operações 24x7.    Experiência em empresas de grande porte e operações nacionais.       ✅ Benefícios que fazem a diferença:   Plano de Saúde Nacional Plano Odontológico Seguro de Vida Vale Alimentação Convênio Farmácia Wellhub (Gympass) Parcerias com universidades Programa Saber Viver Assistência ao Empregado (PAE) e Telemedicina ✏ Auxílio Material Escolar PLR Plano de saúde pra pets (Guapeco) Pack mensal, Kit Aniversariante e Natal

title: Analista de crédito junior
description:
Nova oportunidade para Analista de crédito junior em são bernardo do campo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Na Sherwin-Williams, nós colorimos o mundo! Com mais de 85 anos de história no Brasil e fazendo parte de uma marca global com mais de 150 anos, somos líderes na indústria de tintas e revestimentos, reconhecidos por nossa inovação, qualidade e compromisso com a sustentabilidade.      Estamos em busca de um Analista de Crédito Júnior, para a região de São Bernardo do Campo, para atuar no suporte às atividades relacionadas à gestão de crédito, cobrança e recebíveis da companhia, realizando análises, controles e acompanhamento de clientes, em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da área, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e para os resultados da companhia.      Requisitos Experiência de até 2 anos em atividades de crédito, cobrança, contas a receber ou áreas financeiras correlatas. Desejável vivência em rotinas administrativas e financeiras, além de relacionamento com clientes internos e externos. Boa comunicação, organização, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade analítica. Desejável conhecimento em sistemas ERP, preferencialmente Oracle ou similares. Português fluente e conhecimento básico de inglês será considerado diferencial. Conhecimentos em análise de crédito, demonstrações financeiras, fluxo de caixa e indicadores financeiros. Conhecimento de pacote Microsoft Office, com ênfase em Excel avançado para elaboração e manutenção de relatórios e controles. Desejável conhecimento em Power-Point e Power BI    Formação acadêmica Curso Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Administração de Empresas, Economia (Ou similares) Pós – Graduação em Administração ou em outras áreas correlatas (Desejável)    Responsabilidades Apoiar a área comercial na análise cadastral e na coleta de informações econômico-financeiras necessárias para avaliação de crédito de clientes. Executar análises de crédito para concessão, renovação e manutenção de limites de crédito, seguindo as políticas, normas e diretrizes estabelecidas pela companhia. Realizar consultas em bureaus de crédito e outras fontes de informação, apoiando a avaliação da situação econômico-financeira e do comportamento de pagamento dos clientes. Auxiliar na revisão periódica dos limites de crédito dos clientes ativos, identificando alterações relevantes e reportando situações de risco à liderança. Realizar a liberação diária de pedidos para faturamento, verificando a situação financeira dos clientes e observando os limites de crédito e regras estabelecidas. Interagir com as áreas de Cobrança, Administração de Vendas e Comercial para obtenção e compartilhamento de informações relacionadas aos clientes sob sua responsabilidade. Elaborar e atualizar relatórios, planilhas e controles da área, garantindo a qualidade e confiabilidade das informações. Apoiar a elaboração de análises, estudos e pareceres de crédito para suporte às decisões da área. Acompanhar indicadores da área de Crédito e Cobrança, contribuindo na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e mitigação de riscos. Participar de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, automação e simplificação de processos relacionados à gestão de crédito e cobrança. Prestar suporte às áreas clientes, fornecendo informações e esclarecimentos relacionados aos processos e procedimentos da área. Participar, contribuir e assegurar que o Sistema Integrado de Gestão (Qualidade, Ambiental e Saúde e Segurança no Trabalho) seja mantido em todos os níveis sob sua responsabilidade. Estar sempre informado sobre suas atribuições, responsabilidades e consequências de suas atividades, comportamento e tomadas de decisão, contribuindo para seu desenvolvimento profissional. Prestar atendimento e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo, conforme orientação e/ou solicitação do superior imediato. Compartilhar conhecimentos, colaborar com a equipe e buscar constante desenvolvimento técnico e profissional Conhecimento e colaborar com os demais integrantes da equipe, contribuindo para a padronização das melhores práticas de análise e gestão de crédito

title: Product analyst - vmake (ai video & content creation)
description:
Confira a vaga para Product analyst - vmake (ai video & content creation) em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A quick note before you apply: please submit your resume in English. As this role involves regular collaboration with international teams, we’re looking for someone who is comfortable using English as a working language.      Why We Need You    We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.      You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.      What You’ll Do Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience. Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements. Monitor trends across Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, You Tube Shorts, Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations. Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning. Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps. Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations. Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration. Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch. Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.    Who You Are 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within Saa S, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology. Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms. Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies. Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data. Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.    Preferred Qualifications Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence. Experience with Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms. Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery. Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma. Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

Sobre nós:    O Grupo Maringá atua nos segmentos da Siderurgia e do Sucroenergético. Produzimos Ferroliga de Manganês, Cana-de-Açúcar, Açúcar, Etanol e Energia, contribuindo para o provimento de aço, alimentos, biocombustível e energia, elementos fundamentais para o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil e do Mundo. Acompanhar as atividades da equipe de turno, assegurando o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais e identificando oportunidades para criação ou atualização de instruções de trabalho; Acionar e acompanhar serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva, realizando abertura de ordens de serviço, interface com as equipes de manutenção e monitoramento da execução dos trabalhos; Elaborar leitos de fusão conforme planejamento de produção e especificações operacionais, garantindo o correto registro das informações necessárias; Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas de Segurança do Trabalho, identificando condições inseguras, comunicando as áreas responsáveis e implementando ações para eliminação dos riscos; Conduzir investigações de incidentes ocorridos durante o turno, propondo e acompanhando ações corretivas e preventivas; Supervisionar as atividades operacionais do turno, distribuindo tarefas, acompanhando a execução dos trabalhos e garantindo os padrões de qualidade, produtividade e segurança; Avaliar as condições dos insumos utilizados na produção, verificando sua conformidade com as especificações e comunicando desvios às áreas responsáveis; Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, promovendo otimização de processos, redução de custos operacionais e aumento da eficiência produtiva; title: Head of tech risk, brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Head of tech risk, brazil em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Objective: We are seeking an experienced and highly strategic Statutory Risk Officer to    lead our Risk Management function in Brazil. This executive role is pivotal in acting as the    primary interface with local regulatory bodies, specifically the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).    The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Operational and Technology Risk, ensuring    our fast-paced operations remain resilient, secure, and fully compliant.      About the Role    As the Statutory Risk Officer, you will hold statutory responsibility for the company's risk    management framework in Brazil. You will act as the designated point of contact for BACEN and    other relevant regulatory bodies, advocating for the business while ensuring strict adherence to local regulatory expectations. While the role requires holistic oversight of the enterprise risk landscape, the primary mandate is to architect, implement, and govern a robust Operational Risk and Technology Risk framework. You will partner with business and technology leaders to identify vulnerabilities, mitigate technological threats, and foster a culture of proactive risk management.      Key Responsibilities    Regulatory Leadership & Statutory Duties Act as the formally appointed Statutory Risk Director before the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN),fulfilling all duties required by BACEN Resolution and related regulations. Serve as the primary liaison for all regulatory inquiries, audits, and supervisory exams related to risk management. Ensure accurate and timely submission of all mandated risk reports to regulators. Monitor regulatory developments and proactively adapt the risk framework to meet emerging legislative and supervisory requirements.    Operational cum Technology Risk Management Oversee the end-to-end Operational Risk Management (ORM) framework, including Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Incident Management. Establish and monitor operational risk appetite metrics and thresholds, escalating breaches to the management Drive business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategies to ensure operational resilience. Provide in-depth oversight of Technology Risk, Information Security, and Cyber Security frameworks. Evaluate risks associated with digital transformations, cloud migrations, API integrations, and new technology deployments. Oversee Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), focusing heavily on critical IT vendors and outsourced technology service providers. Review and challenge incident response protocols and post-mortem analysis for IT disruptions or cyber incidents.    Financial Risk (Advantageous Focus)    Good knowledge over end-to-end financial, fraud risk management during payment and money conversion and transfer process, for dual B2 C (high-volume, rapid retail transactions) and B2 B (high-value invoice/account-to-account payouts) flows.      Requirements Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or related field. Strong experience in risk management and/or internal controls within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (banks, payment institutions, brokerages, or asset managers). Solid working knowledge of BCB regulatory processes, norms, and resolutions. Prior experience engaging directly with BCB and/or CVM in a regulatory/supervisory context. Strong understanding of prudential risk frameworks (capital, RWA, operational risk). Brazilian national or foreign national with valid Brazilian residency (statutory officer requirement). Availability and willingness to be formally listed as a company officer with associated legal responsibilities. Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English. Prior experience in virtual assets, crypto, or fintech risk management. Domain Expertise: SME-level knowledge in Operational Risk and Technology/Cyber Risk methodologies. Professional certifications in risk management (e.g., FRM, CRM) a plus. Familiarity with VASP-specific prudential frameworks and evolving BCB guidance on RWA treatment for digital asset activities.    P/S: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to overwhelming applicants.      Vision & Mission    OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.      OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled
description:
Nova oportunidade para Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Emperor Rentals is a U. S. vacation-rental and real-estate business seeking a hands-on Finance & Accounting Manager based in Brazil for a full-time remote position, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time. You will work with our Portuguese-speaking team and communicate clearly in English with U. S. management and our external accountant.      This is a very hands-on individual-contributor role. You will personally perform day-to-day bookkeeping and financial housekeeping: clean up transactions, organize receipts, reconcile accounts, prepare owner statements, and produce recurring reports. You will own follow-through from source documents to accurate books and completed reporting. You will also improve these financial workflows using AI.      COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE    USD $250 per week. Required schedule: FULL-TIME, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time (New York time, following Eastern daylight-saving changes). You must be available for this fixed schedule; general time-zone overlap is not sufficient. Confirm your availability and acceptance of this weekly budget in your proposal. Long-term collaboration is intended, subject to performance and mutual agreement.      WHAT YOU WILL OWN   - Daily Quick Books Online bookkeeping across separate legal entities: bank/card feeds, accurate categories, property classes, receipts, and an aged exception list.   - Bank and credit-card reconciliations to actual statements, with every difference explained and supporting documents retained.   - Owner Rez accounting: reconcile property expenses and owner statements to Quick Books, distinguish reimbursements from service income, and prepare weekly property-management transfer schedules for approval.   - Keep guest/owner trust funds, operating cash, intercompany transfers, owner distributions, and business income correctly separated.   - Reconcile Airbnb, Vrbo, , Stripe and other payouts, fees, commissions, refunds and chargebacks to bookings and bank deposits.   - Prepare monthly owner statements and property-level reports, apply review corrections promptly, and track completion through final approval.   - Support weekly payroll and contractor-payment reconciliation across time/work records, payment-provider records and the bank, including fees and failed or duplicate payments.   - Retrieve mortgage and utility support, prepare principal/interest/escrow allocations, and maintain property-specific records.   - Deliver monthly P& L, balance-sheet support, reconciliation schedules and a clear list of unresolved items. Support W-9/1099 preparation under the external accountant's approved instructions.      AI-ASSISTED ACCOUNTING   - Use approved AI tools to help extract invoice data, propose transaction classifications, compare exports, investigate differences, draft reports and document procedures.   - Build repeatable spreadsheet and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve accuracy.   - Verify every AI-generated calculation, classification and proposed entry against source documents. Keep a clear audit trail and follow company data-access policies.   - Retain personal responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of the books, and obtain required approval before posting adjustments or releasing payments.      REQUIRED EXPERIENCE   - At least 3 years of hands-on U. S. bookkeeping/accounting and Quick Books Online, with ownership of reconciliations, monthly close and financial reporting.   - Either practical experience using AI tools in finance/accounting, OR a strong willingness to learn and consistently use AI in our financial workflows. Prior AI expertise is not required; careful verification, curiosity and adoption of our tools are required.   - Strong bank reconciliation, double-entry accounting, balance-sheet cleanup and multi-entity experience.   - Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables and reconciling large exports.   - Professional Portuguese and strong written/spoken English. Based in Brazil for team collaboration and working-hour alignment.   - Ability to spot duplicates, missing receipts, incorrect periods, wrong properties and unsupported classifications without waiting for the owner to find them.   - Reliable internet, a suitable work computer, and willingness to use Hubstaff for agreed work-time reporting.      STRONGLY PREFERRED    Property management, vacation rentals, real estate or trust/owner accounting; Owner Rez; OTA/Stripe payout reconciliation; Quick Books Pro Advisor certification; familiarity with Slack, Notion, Operto or similar operations tools. An accounting degree is welcome.      HOW WE DEFINE GOOD WORK    Accurate reconciliations, clear evidence and dependable completion dates. Review new bank-feed items each business day and process supported items within one business day where possible. Escalate missing information with an owner and due date. Reconcile before declaring work complete. Flag unclear instructions, explain accounting implications, document decisions and improve repetitive workflows. Payment release and tax decisions remain subject to management/accountant approval.      TO APPLY   1. Describe your U. S. Quick Books and property-management experience, including the number of entities/accounts you managed.   2. Explain how you would handle a property repair paid by Operations and later reimbursed from owner funds without double-counting income.   3. Describe a bookkeeping error you discovered, how you proved it and how you prevented recurrence.   4. Explain your monthly-close checklist and how you track missing receipts and unresolved differences.   5. Describe how you currently use AI, or confirm your willingness to learn and use AI in our financial workflows. Explain how you would check its output for accuracy.   6. Confirm your location in Brazil, English/Portuguese proficiency, availability for the full-time Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern schedule, and acceptance of USD $250 per week.      Please share only anonymized examples with no client financial details. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a separately agreed paid practical exercise using sample data. We value sound judgment, careful work and clear communication.

Experience & Knowledge 4+ years of experience in Human Resources, HR Operations, HR Systems, Continuous Improvement, or related areas. Strong understanding of HR operations, employee data governance, and process management. Proven ability to identify operational challenges and implement scalable solutions. Experience with Service Now or similar case management platforms. Experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or other Continuous Improvement methodologies. Experience in HR Digital Transformation initiatives. Familiarity with RPA technologies such as Ui Path or Automation Anywhere. Certification in Continuous Improvement, Process Excellence, Lean, Six Sigma, or Project Management.    About Us    At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Buscamos a liderança que vai conceber, construir e conduzir toda a operação comercial desse projeto, do pré-lançamento à maturidade das vendas. É uma posição de construção, não de manutenção: a estrutura, o time, os canais e a cultura comercial serão desenhados por você. time-chave contratado, central de vendas e sala de experiência em operação, CRM implantado e base de interessados qualificada   • Até 12 meses: operação pronta para o lançamento, com disciplina de funil, previsibilidade de receita e atendimento no nível da melhor hotelaria      RESPONSABILIDADES   • Definir a estratégia comercial: segmentação, posicionamento de oferta, política de preços por canais), com responsabilidade integral pelo funil de vendas   • Abrir e desenvolver canais de alta renda: private banking, family offices, boutiques imobiliárias, empresas e redes de relacionamento   • Implantar e operar a central de vendas e a sala de experiência   • Assegurar que toda a atividade comercial observe rigorosamente as diretrizes jurídicas e regulatórias do projeto   • Atuar em conjunto com marketing, desenvolvimento, jurídico e operações, levando a voz do cliente para as decisões de produto   • Reportar resultados à liderança com indicadores semanais e revisões mensais de desempenho      COMPETÊ NCIAS ESSENCIAIS   • Liderança construtora: forma times e cultura a partir do zero   • Venda consultiva de alto valor: credibilidade para se relacionar com empresários, executivos e famílias de altíssima renda   • Gestão orientada por dados: funil, conversão, forecasting e ciclo de vendas   • Integridade e conformidade: entende que reputação é o principal ativo nesse mercado   • Mentalidade de hospitalidade: vende experiência e estilo de vida, não metro quadrado      EXPERIÊ NCIA E FORMAÇÃ O   • 10+ anos em vendas no segmento de luxo, sendo 5+ em liderança comercial com gestão de times e metas   • Participação comprovada em lançamentos de real estate de luxo, branded residences, resorts ou hospitalidade premium   • Histórico de resultados em ciclos longos e com ticket elevado   • Rede ativa de relacionamento com público de alta renda, preferencialmente no Sul do Brasil   • Formação superior completa; MBA ou especialização em gestão é desejável   • Diferenciais: inglês fluente e experiência com marcas ou parceiros internacionais      O QUE OFERECEMOS   • Papel estratégico com autonomia real e acesso direto ao CEO   • Pacote de remuneração competitivo, com fixo e variável relevante atrelado a entregas e resultados   • A oportunidade de assinar a construção de uma operação comercial de referência   • Ambiente empreendedor, com decisões rápidas e parceiros de primeira linha      PROCESSO SELETIVO   1. Triagem curricular e conversa inicial   2. Entrevista com a liderança   3. Case prático: apresentação de uma estratégia comercial   4. Acordo de confidencialidade e apresentação completa do projeto   5. Checagem de referências e proposta      DIVERSIDADE E INCLUSÃ O    Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias, perspectivas e origens. Se você se identifica com o desafio, mas não atende a todos os requisitos, candidate-se mesmo assim.      CONFIDENCIALIDADE    Todas as candidaturas são tratadas com sigilo. Os detalhes do projeto são compartilhados apenas nas etapas finais, mediante acordo de confidencialidade.

description:

Accountant / Full-Charge Bookkeeper (2 Openings)    Full-Time, 40 hrs/week | PST-overlap schedule (South America afternoon hours) | Long-Term Contract & Remote      About the Role    A U. S.-based business management and accounting firm serving clients in the entertainment industry is looking for two experienced accounting professionals to join their remote team. Both roles handle full-charge bookkeeping and day-to-day accounting operations end-to-end; one of the two positions carries an additional focus on U. S. tax preparation. Key Responsibilities Handle full-charge bookkeeping from transaction entry through financial reporting Record and categorize financial transactions accurately in accordance with U. S. GAAP Perform bank and account reconciliations Manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) Process and support payroll activities Prepare and maintain financial statements and accounting records Assist with financial analysis and account review Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on open account issues Support client bill payment and accounting-related business management activities Work primarily in Quick Books and the firm's internal workflow systems, including Tax Dome Follow established internal procedures while proactively communicating discrepancies, unusual transactions, or client issues to management    Requirements    Both Positions 3+ years of relevant accounting or full-charge bookkeeping experience preferred; demonstrated depth of competency matters more than years alone Strong understanding of U. S. GAAP Hands-on experience with: bank reconciliations, AP, AR, payroll, and financial statement preparation Strong Quick Books proficiency (daily operational use) Ability to work independently with limited supervision High attention to detail and accuracy Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Comfortable managing multiple client accounts in a fast-paced environment Strong written and verbal English communication; proactive about flagging issues Experience with U. S.-based companies or accounting firms is a strong plus Tax Dome experience is a plus CPA designation is not required    Position 2 — Additional Requirements (Tax Preparation Focus) Hands-on experience preparing U. S. tax returns Working knowledge of U. S. taxation and basic IRS requirements Experience supporting a U. S. CPA, tax practice, or accounting firm strongly preferred Enrolled Agent (EA) designation is a plus but not required Must be prepared to deepen tax knowledge under the firm's direct guidance    Ideal Candidate    You already understand accounting fundamentals and don't need to be trained on the basics — you can independently handle a bank reconciliation, manage AP/AR, and produce clean financial statements without step-by-step guidance. You're sharp, self-directed, and you flag problems before they escalate rather than waiting to be asked. You take real ownership of accuracy in your work and are comfortable serving multiple clients in a fast-moving environment. For Position 2, you bring practical exposure to U. S. tax return preparation and are ready to build on that foundation under the firm's coaching.

Experiência prévia como Product Designer, preferencialmente em techs, fintechs, e-commerces ou ambientes digitais acelerados. Domínio de Figma e prototipagem de interfaces. Conhecimento prático e consistente em Design Systems. Inglês avançado, com segurança para interagir com stakeholders de fora do Brasil. Requisitos     * Formação completa em Enfermagem;   * Registro profissional ativo no COREN;   * Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;   * Organização e responsabilidade com acompanhamento de pacientes;   * Facilidade com atendimento digital e Whats App;   * Perfil acolhedor, paciente e cuidadoso;   * Capacidade de seguir protocolos e reconhecer situações que necessitem de avaliação médica.      Será um diferencial:    Experiência com cirurgia plástica, centro cirúrgico, recuperação pós-operatória, atendimento em clínicas ou acompanhamento de pacientes cirúrgicos.      Modelo de trabalho      Atendimento predominantemente remoto/online, realizado através do Whats App, com acompanhamento das pacientes da clínica durante o período pós-operatório.      Mais do que responder dúvidas, buscamos uma profissional que acompanhe de perto cada paciente, proporcionando segurança, acolhimento e continuidade do cuidado durante uma das etapas mais importantes da experiência com a clínica.

title: Queue lead
description:
Confira a vaga para Queue lead em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Start date: TBC    End Date: TBC    Location: Remote    Type of contract: Freelance    Languages required: English    Hourly Rate: Include the rate you are comfortable with on your CV.    About Prolific    Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.      The Role    We are seeking a Queue Lead to join a high-priority initiative in partnership with a leading AI company. This is an operational, hands-on role, you will own day-to-day execution for one or more annotation queues on a live AI training/eval program: managing throughput, running quality calibrations, tracking contributor performance, and building out reporting systems that keep stakeholders informed in real time.    You will have experience running queues and quality on AI data programs. The selected candidate will be able to speak to specific projects, calibration processes they’ve built, and contributor performance systems they’ve run.      What you'll be doing    Queue Operations & Task Management Own work queues: intake, triage, prioritization, task assignment, and SLA delivery Monitor task queue and backlog control Identify and troubleshoot bottlenecks (unclear policy, tooling issues, supply gaps)  Quality Assurance & Performance Management Monitor quality at project and individual annotator or contributor level. Perform QA tasks such as making corrections, providing annotator feedback, flagging systematic confusion and suggestions to team lead. Manage annotator or contributor performance by performing tasks like unassigning underperformers, identifying and retaining high-performers.  Reporting & Dashboards Build and maintain dashboards to track throughput, disagreement rates, defect or rework rates, and contributor performance. Turn raw queue data into clear, actionable reporting for stakeholders. Provide feedback for process improvements based on data trends.  Training & Support Oversee dedicated Slack channels by answering participant questions, providing support, and escalating complex issues to the Client Delivery Lead. Train new annotators or contributors on project guidelines. Conduct live or recorded webinars as new participants join projects. Host "office hours" for participants. Oversee dedicated Slack channels by answering questions, providing support, escalating complex issues to Client Delivery Lead.    What you'll bring Proven, direct experience running queues and quality on AI data programs, ideally at a competitor. 3+ years in high-throughput ops (data labeling, trust & safety, BPO, content ops, CX ops), with recent, specific AI data ops experience Able to identify shallow, low-effort, AI-generated, or phoned-in responses. Proven ability to design and run calibration processes from scratch. Ability to track record by building or maintaining dashboards or reporting systems (spreadsheets is required, SQL/BI/Looker/Tableau a strong plus) Experience managing contributor performance at scale including making retention or removal decisions. Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities on live programs.    What "good" looks like for us: Scale up to running a full AI end-to-end data program, owning pipeline, throughput, calibration, and contributor performance at program level. Operates as an AI training consultant, you are comfortable advising on processes and methodology.    Bonus Experience with ML data or LLM eval workflows (ranking, rubric-based judging, gold sets, calibration) Distributed team coordination across time zones; vendor or contract workforce experience Consulting-style experience of advising clients on AI training methodology.    Success looks like    Predictable SLA delivery, a stable backlog, improving quality and reducing rework, and proactive dashboards reporting that give stakeholders real-time visibility.      Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant  Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.    We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.    We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.      Links to more information on Prolific      Privacy Statement  By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Estagiário de controle de qualidade
description:

Sobre Phibro Animal Health Corporation    A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para ser um parceiro confiável para os produtores de gado, aves, suínos e aquacultura, agricultores, veterinários e consumidores que criam ou cuidam de animais de produção e de companhia, fornecendo soluções para ajudá-los a manter e melhorar a saúde de seus animais.    A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.    As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.    A posição de Estagiário de Controle de Qualidade é um componente importante de nosso time de Qualidade localizado em Guarulhos - SP.      Detalhes de posição    Auxiliar na qualificação de equipamentos e validação de métodos analíticos, bem como realizar validações de planilhas diversas, sob supervisão constante e observando as Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL).      Responsabilidades chave     Realizar análises microbiológicas e/ou químicas e/ou físico-químicas (por exemplo: testes de p H, aparência, granulometria, perda por secagem, teor de água, dentre outros) de amostras em processo, matéria-prima e/ou produto acabado. Preparar meios de cultura, realizar testes de presença de microrganismo estranho (PME,) avaliar as cepas produtoras e/ou microrganismo estranho através de microscopia, preparar esfregaços, inocular meios de cultura. Conhecer e aplicar as técnicas adequadas de esterilização e assepsia. Amostrar germinador, fermentador e tanque de adição, além da planta piloto, sendo essa atividade específica para os laboratórios de Controle de Processo e Desenvolvimento de Fermentação, mas necessita de acompanhamento. Acompanhar todo o processo de qualificação térmica, inclusive documentação. Acompanhar todo o processo de validação de método analítico, inclusive documentação. Realizar verificações / aferições rotineiras de equipamentos e realizar as leituras ambientais. Transferir materiais diversos do almoxarifado e depósito para o laboratório. Preparar, transportar e organizar amostras de retenção para todos os produtos analisados no Laboratório de Controle de Qualidade. Registrar a entrada de materiais do laboratório. Entregar ou retirar junto ao departamento de compras as requisições de materiais e documentos. Colagem de etiquetas com o status das matérias-primas / embalagem, se necessário. Preparar / fracionar amostras para o programa de estabilidade. Preparar amostras de retenção para os produtos conforme procedimento CQ.1005.ur (última revisão). Preparar reagentes e soluções rotineiras de laboratório. Manter atualizado os registros analíticos e outros documentos. Preparar e lavar material. Manter organizada, limpa e identificada à área de trabalho. Reportar ao superior imediato à necessidade de material de consumo e/ou equipamento que necessite de manutenção e/ou calibração para que as análises sejam precisas e contemplem as normas de BPL. Seguir rigorosamente as normas de BPL e BPF, consultar a FDS (Ficha com Dados de Segurança) e utilizar os EPI’s (Equipamento de Proteção Individual) adequados.    Formação & Especializações: Ensino Superior Cursando Engenharia Química ou Bacharel em Química com formação prevista a partir de 2028.    Localidade: Guarulhos    Horário de estágio: Segunda a Sexta-feira das 08h às 15h      Phibro é uma empresa que propicia oportunidades iguais a todos    Todos os candidatos qualificados para a posição serão considerados independentemente de raça, nacionalidade, sexo, idade, religião, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, condição de veterano, estado civil ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

title: Assistente jurídico b2b com 2 anos de experiência em grandes escritórios
